title: hello
description: First frame on the signaling connection, sent by the bench right after the WebSocket opens. The hub closes with 1002 when it is not a hello or has an empty agent_id, and with 1008 when the token is wrong (src/alb/api/agent_route.py:187-200). The hub tolerates the absence of build/ops/flash_partitions/boards/update (older benches, src/alb/api/agent_route.py:210-223); the current bench always sends every field (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:408-441), so all of them are required here. The hub-side builder protocol.hello() sends fewer fields (known-gaps G2).

agent_id.description: Stable identity of this bench. Must contain a non-blank character (the hub strips it and closes 1002 when empty). Reconnecting with the same id replaces the previous registration.

name.description: Human-readable bench name. The hub falls back to agent_id when empty.

agent_version.description: Carries the PROTOCOL version (1), not a program version. Stored by the hub, never compared (known-gaps G1).

caps.description: Capability strings. Values in use: "adb" (always), "fastboot" (only when a fastboot executable resolves on the bench host). Unknown values are ignored by the hub.

ops.description: The bench op table, one OpDesc per op. The hub drops malformed rows individually (src/alb/remote/bench_ops.py:180-244).

flash_partitions.description: Legacy partition allowlist. Always [] since ADR-070 (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:430-434); kept for hubs that still read it.

boards.description: Boards whose identity the bench checks before a write, keyed by board name. The hub drops entries whose name does not match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ (src/alb/remote/bench_board.py:43, 301-319).

partitions.description: Always null from the current bench (no list limits names, ADR-070). null means not configured, never 'none'.

product.description: What `fastboot getvar product` must answer before a write to this board.

update.description: Outcome of the last remote self-update as recorded by the bench update helper, or null when there is none. The hub reads outcome=pending from a hello whose build equals to_build as updated (src/alb/remote/registry.py:74-89).

token.description: Shared bench token, or null when none is configured. The only credential on the signaling connection; no HTTP header carries it there.
